sources.content: Appointments may be cancelled without charge at least 24 hours before the start time. Pembatalan percuma mesti dibuat sekurang-kurangnya 24 jam lebih awal. 预约开始前至少二十四小时可以免费取消。
Customers may reschedule an appointment through their management link until 12 hours before it begins.
Customer parking is available beside the north entrance. Use the blue visitor bays and bring the parking ticket to reception.
Arrival time and check-in. How early should customers arrive? Please arrive ten minutes before the appointment so reception can complete check-in.
Deposits and advance payment. Do long treatments need payment in advance? A fifty ringgit deposit is required for services longer than ninety minutes. The deposit is applied to the final bill.
The ground-floor treatment rooms are wheelchair accessible. An accessible toilet is located next to reception.
Children under sixteen must attend with a parent or legal guardian.
Payment methods. Can customers pay with DuitNow? The business accepts Visa, Mastercard, DuitNow QR and cash. Cheques are not accepted.
Customers more than fifteen minutes late may receive a shorter service so later appointments remain on schedule.
Pets and animals. Can customers bring a pet to an appointment? Only trained service animals are allowed inside the appointment premises.
An obsolete policy promised a full refund after every completed appointment.
The private code for the other business is ORANGE-OWL.
